propositions: Reconciler read and check paths construct Jira backends that reload ambient settings, causing read scope to change during execution or discard supplied registry configuration.

ReconcilerSettings, GitRuntime, and BridgeRuntime projections must be immutable, with a single selected backend (Jira Cloud or Data Center) constructed from stable bindings whose project/query scope, TLS, timeout, limits, tracker layout, and auth remain fixed for the operation.

All read/check call paths including preflight, access check, fetch, paging, diff, mapping, binding reads, and Git ref/layout operations must consume the supplied runtime projection instead of calling load_config() or inspecting ambient environment/cwd/tracker layout.
Secrets in runtime carriers (SecretStr/SecretBytes) must be excluded from repr, equality, hash, cache, and fingerprint, and unwrapped only in the selected Jira sending adapter.

Supplied Python config, custom tracker directory/branch/remote, and empty Cloud read scope must be authoritative; missing/conflicting auth and malformed config/TLS/URL must fail before any Jira model request or local write.

Existing read/check provider-neutral outputs remain equal except for approved explicit-input, fail-fast, and stable-property deltas; ambient mutations after composition cannot alter an operation's read scope or backend properties.
